name: twnm-benchmark-foa
description:
TWNM FOA Final Evaluation Benchmark
	

This is the benchmark used in our final evaluation and corresponds to the benchmark introduced in our paper
"The World is Not Mono: Enabling Spatial Understanding in Large Audio-Language Models".
Reference:

Yuhuan You, Lai Wei, Xihong Wu, and Tianshu Qu. The World is Not Mono: Enabling Spatial Understanding in Large Audio-Language Models. arXiv:2601.02954v2, 2026.


	
		
	
	
		Contents
	


1,000 FOA audio clips
1,000 multiple-choice questions
4… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/shuitata618/twnm-benchmark-foa.
reputation: A recently introduced task-specific benchmark (from the authors' 2026 paper) for spatial audio understanding in audio-language models; currently emerging with limited external adoption.
